updates.title: Microsoft Purview: View-Only Device Management Role for Endpoint DLP
updates.summary: A new least-privilege role enables auditors and security analysts to view device onboarding status without requiring broad administrative permissions like Compliance Administrator or Global Administrator. This granular RBAC control improves security posture by limiting unnecessary access to Endpoint DLP device management features.

updates.title: CVE-2026-109460: Microsoft Entra Private Network Connector Information Disclosure
updates.summary: An authorized attacker can exploit exposure of sensitive information in Microsoft Entra Private Network Connector to disclose information locally. Organizations using Entra connectors for hybrid identity scenarios should apply this security patch to prevent data leakage.

updates.title: CVE-2026-105590: Windows AD Certificate Services Security Feature Bypass
updates.summary: Improper certificate validation in Windows Active Directory Certificate Services allows an authorized attacker to bypass security controls over the network, potentially compromising certificate-based authentication and trust chains. Organizations should update immediately to maintain certificate security integrity.

updates.title: CVE-2026-121680: Windows NTLM Spoofing Vulnerability
updates.summary: A spoofing vulnerability in Windows NTLM affects Microsoft Office and other Microsoft products, allowing attackers to impersonate legitimate users or services. Admins managing identity and authentication systems should ensure all supported Office versions are updated to close this identity-layer attack vector.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Permissions Audit Log Improvements
updates.summary: Enhanced audit logs now provide clearer visibility into role and scoped-role access decisions within the Microsoft Purview portal. This improvement helps administrators troubleshoot access issues more effectively and monitor authorization outcomes to ensure proper compliance and least-privilege enforcement.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Auto-Labeling Scale Increase for SharePoint and OneDrive
updates.summary: Maximum auto-labeling capacity increased from 100,000 to 500,000 files per tenant per day, enabling organizations to classify and protect significantly more data at rest faster. This enhancement helps close labeling gaps and prepare data estates for Microsoft 365 Copilot with greater confidence.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Auto-Labeling Per-Policy Coverage Report
updates.summary: Administrators can now view per-policy coverage reports showing which files have been labeled, remain unlabeled, and how enforcement correlates to simulation runs. This granular visibility helps track labeling progress and identify files processed during enforcement that weren't captured in simulation.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Adaptive Scope Lifecycle Status Evaluation Control
updates.summary: Administrators gain explicit control over how lifecycle-state evaluation is applied to recipients and site owners in Adaptive Scopes, ensuring policy targeting and scope membership stay aligned with organizational requirements. This improves precision in data governance and compliance policy application.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Sensitivity Labels for Microsoft Entra Security Groups
updates.summary: Sensitivity labels published in the Microsoft Purview portal now automatically apply to Microsoft Entra cloud security groups using the same configuration already in place for Microsoft 365 groups and sites. This extends classification and governance capabilities without requiring separate label setup.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint DLP Policy Sync & Device Health AI-Powered Investigation
updates.summary: AI-powered capabilities now provide visibility into DLP policy deployment across devices, helping admins track sync progress, identify impacted devices, explain sync failure root causes, and receive guided remediation steps. This reduces time spent troubleshooting policy enforcement issues.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: DSPM Copilot Readiness and Data Explorer
updates.summary: New experiences in Microsoft Purview Data Security Posture Management provide security teams with visibility into data security posture, sensitive data exposure, oversharing, and protection coverage to assess readiness for Microsoft Copilot. This helps prioritize remediation efforts based on data risk.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Auto-Labeling Scalability, Policy Management, and Reporting Enhancements
updates.summary: Improvements to auto-labeling expand support for larger SharePoint scopes, improve policy management flexibility, and provide richer visibility into labeling activity across the organization. These enhancements support enterprise-scale classification and governance operations.

updates.title: CVE-2026-109467: Azure DevOps Server Remote Code Execution
updates.summary: Improper authentication in Azure DevOps Server allows an authorized attacker to execute code remotely over the network, potentially compromising build pipelines, source control, and deployment infrastructure. Organizations should patch immediately to prevent unauthorized code execution.

updates.title: CVE-2026-109455: Microsoft Office SharePoint Information Disclosure
updates.summary: Incorrect authorization in Microsoft Office SharePoint allows an authorized attacker to disclose information over the network. Organizations should patch to prevent unauthorized data exposure through SharePoint access control bypasses.

updates.title: CVE-2026-62903: Microsoft.Data.SqlClient Authentication Bypass
updates.summary: An authentication bypass via capture-replay vulnerability in SQL Server's data client allows unauthorized attackers to disclose information over the network. Organizations using SQL Server for identity or compliance data storage should apply this patch to prevent data exposure.

updates.title: CVE-2026-105588: Windows DHCP Server Elevation of Privilege
updates.summary: Missing authentication for a critical function in Windows DHCP Server allows an authorized attacker to elevate privileges locally. Organizations managing network infrastructure should patch to prevent privilege escalation on DHCP servers.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint DLP Monitors FTP and SFTP Transfers
updates.summary: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention now monitors sensitive data transferred over FTP and SFTP protocols and can apply restrictive actions based on organizational policy. This extends DLP coverage beyond HTTP-based transfers to legacy file transfer methods.
